content: Instagram web DOM: Meta uses CSS-in-JS generating hashed class names that change on EVERY deploy (multiple times per week). Class-based selectors break silently and frequently; semantic attributes (role, aria-label, tagName, time[datetime], itemprop, a[href*='/p/']) are stable. Verified by OmniScrape guide, meta-skills automation flows (selector_drift failure class, verified selectors as of 2026-05), StackOverflow tampermonkey threads, and multiple IG automation extensions. Role=main on feed container is a reliable anchor. Expect ~monthly drift even on semantic selectors; require fallbacks and re-detection. Instagram web is React SSR with window._sharedData hydration blob; field names/endpoints get renamed over time.
